scope: Exact finite models, with source theorems and empirical hypotheses kept distinct. Hypotheses carry the prerequisites stated only in their source; the executed finite interpretations are typed separately as finite checks. Dependency edges are declared obligations, never proofs by their existence; an acyclic, well-typed map does not certify that the extraction from prose is complete.
